steps.name: 01_pane
steps.desc: The Bridge rail item and pane: Planks and Stones tiles, the gesture in the hint

steps.name: 02_plank_near
steps.desc: Dragging from the south bank: once the line nears the water the snapped bridge already shows (ghost deck, plank ticks, a dot on each bank) with its span

steps.name: 03_plank_preview
steps.desc: Still pressed on the far bank: the preview follows the drawn direction and meets both banks

steps.name: 04_plank_placed
steps.desc: Released: the plank bridge, one undo entry

steps.name: 05_refused_hint
steps.desc: A line on dry ground: drawn red, and the reason in plain words beside the cursor

steps.name: 06_refused_toast
steps.desc: Released there: nothing is placed and a toast says why

steps.name: 07_stones_preview
steps.desc: Stepping stones: each stone's outline previewed at its top, a stride apart

steps.name: 08_stones_placed
steps.desc: Released: mossy forest stepping stones, varied sizes

steps.name: 09_stones_close
steps.desc: The stones close up (zoom 6): moss tops, sizes

steps.name: 10_home
steps.desc: Home zoom: the bridge (left) and the stones (right)

steps.name: 11_ctrl_hover
steps.desc: Ctrl held over the bridge: it is outlined in red with 'Remove plank bridge'

steps.name: 14_sculpt_reanchor
steps.desc: A Raise stroke on the far bank: the bridge re-anchors (same id) and its end climbs the mound

steps.name: 15_sculpt_removed_toast
steps.desc: A Tier stroke fills the river under the stones: they go with the water, and a toast says so

steps.name: 16_sculpt_removed
steps.desc: After the tier: no stones on dry ground

steps.name: 17_sculpt_undone
steps.desc: One undo: the ground, the water and the stones come back together

steps.title: P4b-2 Bridge tool
steps.intro: The Bridge tool driven through real input events (mouse motion, press, release, Ctrl) on a new 150 ft temperate forest map with a waist-deep river: the pane, the live preview, a refused line, a plank bridge and stepping stones placed, Ctrl hover and erase and its undo, a sculpt that re-anchors the bridge, a tier that removes the stones with their water, and its undo.
